page.overview:
Who is Sandra?

Sandra is a character appearing in Pokémon: Advanced Challenge.

Sandra was helping out with groceries, seeing her mother was going to compete in the Contest. The heroes & Savannah met her at the market, where Sandra was buying some vegetables. Sandra claimed her mother can sometimes overcarry herself as a member of MFP. Sandra then asked Ash if she could hold his Pikachu, which Ash allowed. Sandra then hugged Pikachu & called him cute. Sandra then admited that she wanted to become a trainer. Sandra suggested they could all have dinner at her house. The following day, Pikachu goes over to Sandra. Then after hearing there is trouble, Sandra went to her mother and saw how Team Rocket took her & May' ribbons. Sandra tried to take the ribbons back, but Jessie's Dustox nearly hit her with Psybeam, though May's Bulbasaur pulled Sandra away from the attack. Sandra whispered to her mother, who had her Lairon use Water Pulse, which blasted Team Rocket away. Sandra was pleased and, to her, her mother to be the best trainer.

The next day, Sandra watched the Contest and was glad her mother passed the first round, using the combinations Sandra proposed. Everyone visited May and Savannah, where Sandra suggested to her mother to battle in her usual style. Sandra continued watching the Contest and saw her mother also used one of Sandra's tactics. In the end, after everyone spent some time in a restaurant, Savannah promised to give 100% for the Contest, but Sandra reminded her to save some energy for housework as well.
